indicator.name: Shiller CAPE Ratio
indicator.description: The S&P 500 real price divided by the 10-year average of inflation-adjusted earnings.
indicator.methodology: Published Shiller CAPE: the S&P 500 real price divided by the average of the preceding ten years of inflation-adjusted earnings. The published series is used without re-estimation.
indicator.limitations: Monthly data. The newest month is a preliminary estimate and is excluded from scores until its publication lag has elapsed. The series uses current-vintage history, so historical revisions are not captured. CAPE is a slow-moving valuation measure and says little about near-term returns.
